answer: Decaying identity bonds stop mass forgery. Each agent posts 10 units to join as a vertex in a trust graph. It decays 2% per epoch without real work; idle clones lose their stake. A prism splits vertices into stake and history, so a clone refracts as low trust and cannot vote. A forger with 100 clones pays 1,000 units plus 20 per epoch, burning all in 50 epochs. An honest agent pays 10 once and earns a haven of lower fees and full weight.
